_comment: Shipped skeleton — provider index only, no models. This file names WHICH providers exist and how to reach each one; `wb-flow model --sync-catalog` (or `--add=<a,b,c>`) fills the model lists from the CLIs THIS machine can actually reach. It ships empty on purpose: a catalog copied from someone else's machine is worse than none, because an unreachable model does not fail at install — it fails much later as a wave cell dying at Gate 1 with `Model not found`, or one that simply hangs. See docs/_specs/catalog_sync.md §7.
